signature: payment error_rate = n% (span status ERROR on charge); checkout error_rate up in step; no latency change.

expected_finding: The adHighCpu feature flag was set to its fault variant; ad is healthy and the failure is injected at the flag layer.

causes.effect: Broker is overloaded and consumers are given an added delay, so lag spikes.

expected_finding: The adFailure feature flag was set to its fault variant; ad is healthy and the failure is injected at the flag layer.

causes.effect: Forced full GC pauses on a loop.

expected_finding: The adManualGc feature flag was set to its fault variant; ad is healthy and the failure is injected at the flag layer.
signature: ad jvm_gc_duration_seconds spikes periodically; sawtooth latency; correlates with GC, not load.
